description: The run flags a tenant run may carry: the engine's allow-list (worker.py:97-118) plus the bounds the API enforces at enqueue (spec §3.1). Order is the engine's argv order. valueRules says what a value of each kind must be; for every kind, a null value or an absent key means the flag is not passed (worker.py:137-141). An unknown key, a wrong kind, a value outside allowed, or a value outside min, max or maxLength is refused with 400 before anything is charged. clientSettable false means a request from the browser carrying the key is refused with 400 (spec §3.1: no raw directionSpec or trackPool from the client); only the API may put it on a manifest.

valueRules.str: a non-empty string (worker.py:143-148); maxLength, when given, counts Unicode code points
valueRules.enum: a string, exactly one of allowed (worker.py:149-151)
valueRules.int: a JSON integer; true and false are refused (worker.py:153-158)
valueRules.float: a JSON number, integer or not; true and false are refused (worker.py:159-164)
valueRules.bool: true or false; true emits the bare CLI flag, false emits nothing (worker.py:165-169)
